fields.description: Below this MAPE (%), a horizon bucket shows a confident, direct price.
fields.label: Direct Suggestion MAPE Threshold

fields.description: Between the direct threshold and this one, a horizon bucket shows a wide scenario range instead of a point price. Above this, nothing is shown - too unreliable to be useful even as a range.
fields.label: Guidance MAPE Threshold

fields.description: A horizon bucket's MAPE is not trusted for gating below this many realized predictions, regardless of how good the score looks - resolves the 0.0-vs-genuinely-perfect ambiguity a never-evaluated commodity would otherwise have.
fields.label: Minimum Sample Size

fields.description: PLACEHOLDER pending Story 3.14's real tuning - the interim report found Prophet's nominal 90% interval only covered 58% of real holdout outcomes, so yhat_lower/yhat_upper are widened by this factor before being shown as a suggested range. Not yet validated against live coverage data.
fields.label: Interval Recalibration Factor
